notes.title: We're On The Steam Store!
notes.notes:
It's been a long time coming, but we're finally out and available on the Steam Store. The app is being offered for an introductory price of 10% off for the first week, so buy it now! 

We want to hear from you, so if you have ideas, drop them on our [url]facebookpage at www.facebook.com/stroodledoodleapp[/url] .
